stem: In a game, a ball is thrown and lands in one of 4 slots, labelled $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$. Raju wishes to test whether the probability that the ball will land in slot $A$ is $\frac{1}{4}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State suitable null and alternative hypotheses for Raju’s test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The ball is thrown 100 times and it lands in slot $A$ 15 times.
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to carry out the test at the 2% significance level.
